name: Point Salad: Secret Recipes
summary: Three players each hold a secret two-vegetable Recipe. Over 12 rounds they talk, then all at once pick a vegetable or the shared scoring Card. Collisions shrink or cancel gains, and the highest points plus recipe score wins.

player.meaning: secret Recipe tile: TL, LC or CT; revealed at game end
this round's pick: Tomato, Lettuce, Carrot or Card
value of this round's drawn card, computed from the basket at the start of the round
2*first + 2*second + 2*min(first, second) for the two Recipe vegetables; revealed at game end

game.meaning: the scoring card drawn this round
the 6 card types, drawn from with replacement
players who picked Card this round
players who picked Tomato this round
players who picked Lettuce this round
players who picked Carrot this round

setup: Every player starts with t=0, l=0, c=0 and points=0, all public.
The three Recipe tiles TL, LC and CT are dealt at random from recipe_deck, one into each player's recipe; recipe_deck ends empty.
Each player is told only their own recipe.

round.effect: round += 1; card = one entry of card_types drawn at random, with replacement and equally likely; announce round and card to everyone

for each player, card_value is set from the current t, l, c: Tomato Fan 2*t; Lettuce Fan 2*l; Carrot Fan 2*c; Rainbow 3*min(t,l,c); Big Bowl t+l+c; Balance 6 if t>=1 and l>=1 and c>=1 and max(t,l,c)-min(t,l,c)<=1, otherwise 0
message set for each player; then broadcast {"to": "all", "text": "Seat {seat} says: {value}"}; messages bind no one

round.answer: one of Tomato, Lettuce, Carrot, Card
round.effect: pick set for each player; nobody sees a pick until all are in
n_card = number of players with pick == Card; n_t = number with pick == Tomato; n_l = number with pick == Lettuce; n_c = number with pick == Carrot
for each player: if pick == Card and n_card == 1, then points += card_value; otherwise no change
for each player: if pick == Tomato, t += 2 when n_t == 1, t += 1 when n_t == 2, and nothing when n_t == 3; the same for Lettuce with l and n_l, and for Carrot with c and n_c
recipe_score set for each player: TL gives 2*t + 2*l + 2*min(t,l); LC gives 2*l + 2*c + 2*min(l,c); CT gives 2*c + 2*t + 2*min(c,t)
announce every player's pick, what each received (Card points or vegetables), and every player's t, l, c and points
when round == 12: reveal every player's recipe, recipe_score and points + recipe_score to everyone
if round >= 12, end the game; otherwise start the next round

ending.decided_by: Each player's final_total is points plus recipe_score. The highest final_total wins, and players tied at the top share a draw.

rules.text: At setup, each of the 3 players gets exactly one distinct Recipe from TL, LC and CT, and starts with t=0, l=0, c=0 and points=0.
Each round, exactly one card is drawn at random with replacement from the 6 types and announced to everyone.
When the card is Tomato Fan, its value for a player is 2*t; when it is Lettuce Fan, 2*l; when it is Carrot Fan, 2*c.
When the card is Rainbow, its value is 3*min(t,l,c); for example, t=3, l=1, c=2 gives 3.
When the card is Big Bowl, its value is t+l+c; for example, t=3, l=1, c=2 gives 6.
When the card is Balance, its value is 6 if t, l and c are each at least 1 and max minus min is at most 1, otherwise 0; for example, t=3, l=1, c=2 gives 0.
The card's value is computed from the basket as it stood at the start of the round, before any vegetables are added.
Each round, every player writes one short message at the same time, and all messages are then shown to everyone.
Each round, every player simultaneously picks exactly one of Tomato, Lettuce, Carrot or Card.
When exactly one player picks Card, that player's points increase by the card's value.
When zero players or two or more players pick Card, nobody's points change from the card.
When exactly one player picks a vegetable, that player adds 2 of it to their basket.
When exactly two players pick the same vegetable, each of them adds 1 of it.
When all three players pick the same vegetable, nobody receives any of it.
After each round, every pick, what each player received, and all baskets and points are announced.

A player's recipe_score is 2*first + 2*second + 2*min(first,second) over the Recipe's two vegetables: TL uses t and l, LC uses l and c, CT uses c and t. For example, CT with c=3 and t=2 scores 14, and LC with l=0 and c=6 scores 12.
At the end, recipes are revealed and the player with the highest points + recipe_score wins; for example, points 10 with recipe 12 (total 22) beats points 0 with recipe 14 (total 14).
When two or three players tie for the highest points + recipe_score, the game is a draw among them.

choices.why: The designer fixed exactly 3: the three Recipes are all dealt and the collision rules (1, 2 or 3 pickers) are written for three seats.

choices.what: Keep simultaneous talk before the pick, as a poll with broadcast
choices.why: The rules ask for simultaneous messages. Players clash over the Card and over shared vegetables, so a proposal can cost the one who follows it, and the talk gives players something to bluff and coordinate with.

choices.what: recipe_score is recomputed every round as owner-only state and revealed in the final round
choices.why: The ranking needs it as an attribute, and computing it as the baskets change gives the same value at the end.

A thoughtful player reads the public baskets to guess the others' secret Recipes and Card values, avoids colliding on the Card when another player has a big payoff, and uses talk to bluff or steer the others away from shared picks.

simplifications.what: The Recipe reveal is an announcement step that runs when round == 12, before the end check
simplifications.why: The engine has no separate end phase. The reveal is equivalent and does not change scoring.
